The credentials API is already documented and available, so I will retrieve the stored file system password and compare it with the current environment's fake timestamps to determine how the original created_at values can be preserved.

```python
account_passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
file_system_password = next(item['password'] for item in account_passwords if item['account_name'] == 'file_system')
print('file_system credentials retrieved')
```
